name: pixel-patrol
description: Pixel Patrol — GDPR drift watchdog. pnpm workspaces: one lockfile, one copy of the fingerprint types.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @pixel-patrol/shared run build && pnpm --filter pixel-patrol-crawler run build && pnpm --filter pixel-patrol-agent run build && pnpm --filter pixel-patrol-demo-sites run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @pixel-patrol/shared run typecheck && pnpm --filter pixel-patrol-crawler run typecheck && pnpm --filter pixel-patrol-agent run typecheck && pnpm --filter pixel-patrol-demo-sites run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @pixel-patrol/shared run test && pnpm --filter pixel-patrol-crawler run test && pnpm --filter pixel-patrol-agent run test && pnpm --filter pixel-patrol-demo-sites run test
